tools.name: inspect_wallet
tools.description: Return SOL balance, all token holdings with USD values, total tracked value and the 10 most recent transactions for a Solana wallet address.

tools.name: check_token
tools.description: Return supply, price, market cap, mint/freeze authority status, metadata mutability, top-20 holders with concentration, and a heuristic rug-risk score for a token mint.

tools.name: explain_transaction
tools.description: Decode a transaction signature: status, fee, programs invoked, SOL and token balance changes, and the last log lines.
